north_star: Convert the professional reference video into renderer-independent, source-bound editing behavior such that a zero-context agent can reconstruct or structurally reuse the editing DNA without arbitrary creative decisions.
hard_barriers: No CANONICAL_TEMPLATE until cross-renderer parity and empirical generalization pass

waves.name: Motion kinematics and easing authority
waves.why: T07 proves screen-space timing/layout but does not yet fully encode velocity, acceleration, settle, overshoot and reusable easing behavior across all golden scenes.
waves.dod: Every reusable motion entity has full-frame or equivalence-proven trajectory plus evidence-bound velocity/settle/easing classification; no renderer-local timing repair remains.
waves.residual: 220 low-amplitude bbox-motion candidates require T08-W2 optical-flow/camera corroboration; exact original easing remains blocked.

waves.name: Camera, depth and occlusion graph
waves.why: The user-visible premium look depends on foreground/midground/background, subject occlusion, 2.5D layering and distinguishing crop/reframe from real/editorial camera behavior.
waves.dod: Every materially visible z/occlusion relation is measured or explicitly UNKNOWN; camera/reframe events have source evidence and no source-native motion is silently promoted to editing grammar.

waves.name: Stimulus and retention grammar
waves.why: Replicating the editing identity requires the cadence of pattern interrupts, caption refreshes, inserts, depth changes, camera changes and deliberate calm windows, not only element geometry.
waves.dod: Every high-salience attention event is represented as a causal event cluster and the reusable retention cadence is measurable without equating object count with quality.

waves.name: Audio-SFX relationship graph
waves.why: S04/S14/S16 have onset proxies but S11 lacks source-bound audio qualification; timbre/envelope/class relationships remain incomplete.
waves.dod: Structural-template mode has evidence-bound audio event timing/function slots for every major golden payoff; exact-source mode keeps stem/timbre unknowns explicit.

waves.name: Typography, color and FX tiering
waves.why: Current gates intentionally separate layout from exact glyphs/materials. T08 must formalize which properties are reusable roles, which are visible-output measurements and which are SOURCE_LOCK/UNKNOWN.
waves.dod: Structural typography/color/FX roles are reproducible without falsely claiming original font, pre-grade token, plugin or hidden AE effect identity.

waves.name: Cross-renderer parity
waves.why: After Effects, Remotion and HyperFrames must execute one canonical EditingGraph rather than drift into independent interpretations.
waves.dod: The three executors remain within declared per-dimension tolerances from the same canonical graph with no renderer-local creative decisions.

waves.name: Three-content generalization
outputs: template identity scorecard without aggregate authority
waves.dod: Three unseen content packs reproduce the editing identity while source-specific media/copy/assets are replaced and no original literal content leaks into the structural template.

next_safe_action: Execute T08-W2 on PR #157 without reopening W1: corroborate the 220 low-amplitude bbox-motion candidates with source-bound optical flow; separate global/editorial reframe from source-native/local motion; construct cycle-free depth/occlusion partial orders; preserve unsupported relations as UNKNOWN; keep all golden renderer branches read-only unless a new regression is demonstrated.
